text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Brisbane are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

sections.text:
For Brisbane luxury **off-the-plan developments, penthouses and architecturally significant projects**, the strongest market-leader shortlist is:

- **Position Property** — the clearest specialist leader for large-scale and boutique project marketing. It reports more than **$5.6 billion in sales**, has won ARERA Agency of the Year, and focuses on off-the-plan, master-planned, boutique and prestige residential projects.[1]
- **Place Estate Agents — particularly the Kangaroo Point and New Farm teams** — a major force in luxury apartment project sales and prestige residential marketing. Simon Caulfield’s team reports more than **$500 million in sales over 10 years** and several sold-out Brisbane developments, including Walan and Haven Newstead.[6]
- **Adcock Prestige** — one of Brisbane’s best-known prestige agencies for luxury homes, penthouses, riverfront properties and architectural residences. It has operated in the city’s luxury market since 2002 and combines high-end residential sales with selected development marketing.[2]
- **Queensland Sotheby’s International Realty** — particularly suitable for globally marketed prestige homes, luxury new developments, heritage properties and architectural residences. Its Brisbane team also offers developer feasibility and project-marketing expertise.[9]
- **North South Real Estate** — a boutique option for high-value apartments, trophy homes and development opportunities where principal-led service, discretion and tailored campaigns are priorities.[3]
- **White & Partners / Whitefox Projects** — worth considering for highly curated, design-led apartment projects and exceptional penthouses. Whitefox was involved in marketing Brisbane’s $17.5 million Heirloom penthouse at Kangaroo Point.[10]

### Best fit by project type

| Requirement | Strongest shortlist |
|---|---|
| Major off-the-plan or multi-stage development | **Position Property**, Place Estate Agents |
| Boutique luxury apartment project | **Place**, Position Property, Whitefox Projects |
| Trophy penthouse or ultra-luxury residence | **Adcock Prestige**, Place, Whitefox Projects |
| Architectural home or design-led residence | **Adcock Prestige**, Queensland Sotheby’s, Place |
| International buyer exposure | **Queensland Sotheby’s**, Adcock Prestige, Position Property |
| Discreet, principal-led campaign | **North South Real Estate**, Adcock Prestige |

**Overall recommendation:** For a developer seeking the deepest Brisbane project-marketing infrastructure, start with **Position Property and Place**. For a landmark penthouse or architecturally distinctive residence, invite proposals from **Adcock Prestige, Place, Queensland Sotheby’s and Whitefox Projects**. Ask each agency for comparable settled sales—not merely listings—along with their buyer database by price bracket, international enquiry data, and evidence of completed sell-outs.
